config/impact.yaml's eur_to_inr_2010, price_index_2010_to_current and default_road_width_m are all status: sourced as of this fixture's generation; docs/decisions.md's 2026-09-25 'M6 loss estimation' entry and docs/impact_outputs.md §5/§6 still describe them as placeholder and say loss_inr must be null — those two docs are stale relative to the current config file. This fixture follows the current config/impact.yaml and backend/m6_impact/loss.py (whose load_asset_values() already validates asset_values.csv against these sourced factors), and flags the discrepancy here rather than silently resolving it in the docs.

only Lachen and Chungthang (named villages, kind: village) are priced, as residential structures; the Teesta III dam, Sangkalang bridge and Mangan district hospital are facilities/infrastructure points (no footprint polygon) and are not priced, matching backend/m6_impact/loss.py's real UNPRICED_CLASSES scope (hospitals, schools, bridges, agriculture)
roads and agriculture are not priced in this preview: no road or cropland exposure layer is joined to this illustrative synthetic valley

the exposed building footprint area per village (6,000 m², from an illustrative 200m×200m village extent at 15% built-up fraction) and the resulting building count (100 per village) are illustrative — this preview's synthetic valley has no real OSM building-footprint join; only the damage-fraction curve and the INR/m² asset value are real, sourced data
low/high sum each village's own p5/p95 depth independently, so the range is wider than the true P10-P90 of total loss (same documented approximation as backend/m6_impact/loss.py's estimate_loss())
JRC max-damage values are 2010 national averages for India; a stone or timber-built house in a Himalayan village may cost quite differently to rebuild than this national average
clear-water model: debris impact and channel-erosion damage are not captured

data_coverage_notes: Population density (150 persons/km²) and the building count/footprint area per village are illustrative — this preview's synthetic valley has no WorldPop, Census or OSM building-footprint join.
